title: Bring the skill bodies back under budget and restore bee-planning's routing hand-off
action: Two defects from the slice 2 and 3 skill rewrites. (1) skill_budget_fence is red: bee-planning 11369 over budget 8139 (+3230), bee-exploring 8677/8163, bee-hive 8542/8183, bee-briefing 8239/8158. Run the fence yourself for the live numbers. The fence's rule is 'pay for new text by removing text, not by appending' -- honor it for bee-exploring, bee-hive and bee-briefing, whose overruns are small and are genuine appended text. bee-planning is the different case and needs a judgment call recorded in your report: it legitimately ABSORBED a whole deleted skill (bee-validating's SMALLER PATH check and merged review wave, per D1/D5), and the repo-wide skill body total went DOWN by far more than 3230 bytes when that tree was deleted. Trim bee-planning hard first -- the absorbed content should land as compact instruction, and much of the old validating prose was ceremony the owner cut. Only re-baseline its budget entry in scripts/skill-body-budget.json for what genuinely cannot compress further, and say plainly in the report how many bytes you re-baselined and why. Do not re-baseline the other three. (2) packages/bee/tests/test_cli_state.mjs expects four shipped routing state-set calls and finds two (bee-compounding, bee-exploring). One of the missing two was bee-validating's and is correctly gone forever; the other was bee-planning's hand-off to swarming, which cell vd-9 removed while cleaning dead references. Restore bee-planning's routing call with its --owner pre-phase declared, and drop the expected count from four to three. Both sides, one cell -- the count and the caller are the same assertion.

truths: bee-planning carries a routing state set call that declares its pre-phase owner
bee-exploring, bee-hive and bee-briefing are back under budget by removing text, not by re-baselining

artifacts.substantive: compact absorbed content plus the restored routing hand-off

key_links: any re-baselined budget number is named and justified in the worker report
